svg.title: M cell
svg.desc: Follicle-associated epithelial M cell with flat sparse-microfold apex, captured antigen, transcytotic vesicles, and a basolateral lymphocyte pocket. Biological basis: M cells sample luminal particles and deliver them across the epithelium to lymphocytes and mononuclear phagocytes housed in a basolateral pocket.
